svg.title: CODE QUEST — Pedro Costinha
svg.desc: Original pixel explorer runs and jumps across platforms derived from PedroCostinha’s real GitHub contribution calendar. 2025-10-19 to 2026-10-22, 259 contributions. Each colored square is one day; gold coins are decorative milestones, not commit counts. The 20.8 second animation loops. Reduced motion shows the complete calendar and finish screen.
